entries.topic: PET-assisted amyloid status modeling (Method Y context)
entries.approximate_range: With direct PET input, AUC can approach 0.85–0.95 in well-paired scans; small-N and class imbalance inflate variance
entries.interpretation_for_this_project: Method Y N=266 exploratory; compare to MRI-only on same hashes only; do not claim AD diagnosis.
